# BorderStyle

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Provides semantic border width presets for common use cases. All values are in points (1/72 inch).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new BorderStyle()
```

## Properties

- [`Hairline`](#hairline): Hairline border - the thinnest practical line (0.25 points).
- [`Heavy`](#heavy): Heavy border (3 points) - very prominent.
- [`Medium`](#medium): Medium border (1.5 points) - slightly emphasized.
- [`None`](#none): No border (0 points)
- [`Normal`](#normal): Normal border (1 point) - standard visible border.
- [`Thick`](#thick): Thick border (2 points) - prominent border.
- [`Thin`](#thin): Thin border (0.5 points) - subtle but visible on most displays.

### `Hairline`

```typescript
static readonly Hairline: 0.25
```

*static, read-only*

Hairline border - the thinnest practical line (0.25 points). May not render on all screens but prints well.

### `Heavy`

```typescript
static readonly Heavy: 3
```

*static, read-only*

Heavy border (3 points) - very prominent. Use sparingly for strong visual emphasis.

### `Medium`

```typescript
static readonly Medium: 1.5
```

*static, read-only*

Medium border (1.5 points) - slightly emphasized. Good for section separators or highlighted elements.

### `None`

```typescript
static readonly None: 0
```

*static, read-only*

No border (0 points)

### `Normal`

```typescript
static readonly Normal: 1
```

*static, read-only*

Normal border (1 point) - standard visible border. The PDF default, reliable across all renderers.

### `Thick`

```typescript
static readonly Thick: 2
```

*static, read-only*

Thick border (2 points) - prominent border. Good for emphasis or outer container borders.

### `Thin`

```typescript
static readonly Thin: 0.5
```

*static, read-only*

Thin border (0.5 points) - subtle but visible on most displays. Good for table cell borders and subtle separators.
